say:16:1121120011:2.text: Our priority is to locate the statue and quell the chaos. Dura's statue is a sacred symbol to the townsfolk. We have to restore it as soon as possible and give the townsfolk an explanation.
say:16:1121120011:2.source_cn: 当务之急是找到女神像的去向，平息骚乱。艾雅是镇民心中神...

say:17:1121120012:1.text: My friend, if this lady really gives off Hypogean magic, as you say, we can't ignore it.
say:17:1121120012:1.source_cn: 朋友，这位女士……如果和你们说的一样，她身上有恶魔的气...

say:18:1121120013:1.text: I understand the situation. What can I do to clear my name? I'll do my best to cooperate.
say:18:1121120013:1.source_cn: 我明白自己的处境。要做什么来洗清我的嫌疑？我会尽力配合。

say:19:1121120014:1.text: Thanks for understanding. If Hypogeans are really involved in this matter, I'm afraid sending ordinary knights to deal with it will only cause casualties.
say:19:1121120014:1.source_cn: 感谢你的理解，如果整件事真的和恶魔有关，让普通骑士应对...

say:20:1121120015:1.text: Apologies, my friend... Just to be safe, let's have her stay with you for now.
say:20:1121120015:1.source_cn: 朋友，抱歉……保险起见，只能让她先跟在你身边了。
